newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker prices firm on good demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker prices firm on good demand.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Thursday were a shade firmer on good demand and tracking strong prices in the European and U.S markets, traders said.
Bunker 180-cst was quoted at $128 by majors and $126 by independents. Bunker 380-cst was indicated at between $121-$122 by independents and majors at $124. Prices were $1-$2 firmer from Wednesday.
"Prices in Rotterdam are very high and some demand has been pushed to the Far East as prices here are more competitive," a trader told Reuters.
MDO prices were stable at $220-228, gas oil at $235-$238.
